channel.title: Stuff Magazine UK - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Stuff Magazine UK (stuff.tv)

item.title: Ring’s plans for Search Party go finding beyond lost dogs – and that’s a concern
item.description: Internal emails have revealed Ring is planning to expand the Search Party feature beyond its cute public face.

item.title: Hate signing PDFs as much as I do? This new Chrome feature will save your sanity
item.description: Chrome can now sign and annotate PDFs in-browser, send them straight to Drive, and even run two tabs side by side

item.title: Apple CarPlay is getting video. But don’t expect Netflix in traffic
item.description: iOS 26.4 beta code suggests Apple TV and AirPlay video are coming to CarPlay – as long as your car is parked.

item.title: This amazing website lets you relive the internet before it got boring. You have to try it
item.description: Opera’s interactive Web Rewind is a playable time machine for the web’s weirdest and greatest moments

item.title: Tech is the villain in the first Toy Story 5 trailer. As a tech reviewer, I have to agree
item.description: Toy Story 5 turns a tablet into the villain, and it perfectly captures the uncomfortable truth about the biggest threat to childhood

item.title: Best handheld gaming consoles in 2026 including Nintendo Switch, Steam Deck and more
item.description: From the Switch to the Steam Deck, we think these are the handheld gaming consoles you can buy right now - rated and reviewed

item.title: OpenAI is planning a smart speaker with a camera designed by Jony Ive – report
item.description: Would you buy a smart speaker with a camera that observes nearby conversations? Made by the company behind ChatGPT?

item.title: EA Sports confirms AI is used for FC 26 in-game commentary
item.description: 20,000 different names pronounced five different ways is a lot for Guy Mowbray to get to. So there's an AI collaboration.

item.title: The future of Xbox just got a huge shake-up
item.description: Spencer is retiring. Bond is resigning. Booty is stepping up. A former Meta VP is taking over and promising to recommit to core Xbox gamers.

item.title: I reviewed the GoPro Max 2, and think it’s a brilliant 360 camera – with a couple of significant issues
item.description: GoPro's second-gen 360 camera isn't perfect, but it shines when the sun is out
